# Scope 3 completion engineering preflight — 31 October 2026

Task: `S3-COMPLETE-20261031-PREFLIGHT`. Executor: `/root/s3_environment_preflight`, CTO role reporting to the root coordinator. This is a read-only local inventory, not a product acceptance or release review.

The requested completion package was **not found**. The PostgreSQL 16 prerequisite is now **ready for runner preparation**: after the initial inventory, the coordinator supplied portable PostgreSQL **16.15**, and this worker independently verified all four required tools and the archive hash. Bun 1.3.12 and a direct Python 3.14.7 interpreter work. Git Bash initially failed in this worker's restricted process context; the coordinator reports a successful version probe outside that context. This is not evidence of a Git Bash product defect. No R43 compatibility or baseline-test pass is claimed.

## PostgreSQL 16 follow-up — supersedes the initial availability finding

Verified directory: `C:/Users/nimab/Neuvetra/m63-runtime/scope3-completion-pg16/pgsql/bin`. Independent `--version` executions for `postgres.exe`, `initdb.exe`, `pg_ctl.exe`, and `psql.exe` each returned PostgreSQL **16.15**, exit 0. Executable hashes match the coordinator's `pg16-tools-verification.json` receipt.

Independent archive check: `C:/Users/nimab/Neuvetra/m63-runtime/scope3-completion-pg16/postgresql-16.15-windows-x64.zip`, **373254386 bytes**, SHA-256 `43bb45f173a6f08cf1d29a97a6d8deb119e8e8093a24c00d2d1001a0ccaa8281`, matching `pg16-download-receipt.json`. The download's publisher/network provenance is recorded by the coordinator; this worker checked local archive bytes, tool versions and hashes. This worker performed no download, extraction, cluster initialization, service start or SQL. Initial observations below are retained as dated first-probe evidence.

| PostgreSQL server | `C:/Users/nimab/Neuvetra/m63-runtime/pgsql/bin/postgres.exe` | `--version`: PostgreSQL 17.11, exit 0 |
| Cluster initializer | Same directory, `initdb.exe` | `--version`: PostgreSQL 17.11, exit 0 |
| Cluster control | Same directory, `pg_ctl.exe` | `--version`: PostgreSQL 17.11, exit 0 |
| SQL client | Same directory, `psql.exe` | `--version`: PostgreSQL 17.11, exit 0 |
| Bun | `C:/Users/nimab/.bun/bin/bun.exe` | `bun --version`: 1.3.12 |
| Python | `C:/Users/nimab/AppData/Local/Python/pythoncore-3.14-64/python.exe` | `--version`: Python 3.14.7; `sys.executable` confirms this path |
| PATH Python/py aliases | `C:/Users/nimab/AppData/Local/Microsoft/WindowsApps/` | Launch fails: file cannot be accessed by the system |
| PowerShell | Current execution shell | `$PSVersionTable.PSVersion.ToString()`: 7.6.5 |
| Git Bash | `C:/Program Files/Git/bin/bash.exe` and `usr/bin/bash.exe` exist | `--version` fails, exit 1: `NtCreateDirectoryObject` access denial `0xC0000022` |

No PostgreSQL binary was on PATH. The conventional `C:/Program Files/PostgreSQL/16/bin` and `C:/Program Files/PostgreSQL` directories do not exist. Bounded executable-name searches covered Neuvetra local runtime/review directories, Downloads, Local Programs, Local Python, Local Temp, .codex, Program Files, Program Files (x86), and the OneDrive project. Only the four PostgreSQL 17.11 binaries above were returned. Local Temp, Program Files and the OneDrive project returned search exit 2 because some directories were inaccessible. Therefore this establishes **PG16 not located**, not a universal proof that PG16 does not exist anywhere on the computer.

The available PowerShell shell does not establish compatibility with the missing `run-r43.sh`. Its required shell, commands, paths and environment remain unknown until the actual runner and R43 README are inspected. No script was run, no WSL distribution was started, and no service action or installation was attempted.

## Package-location evidence

`Test-Path -LiteralPath C:/Users/nimab/Neuvetra/claude-dev/2026-10-31-scope3-completion` returned false.

Filename-only searches for `*R43*`, `*r43*`, and `*scope3-completion*` returned no matches under:

- `C:/Users/nimab/Neuvetra`
- `C:/Users/nimab/Downloads`
- `C:/Users/nimab/.codex/worktrees`
- `C:/Users/nimab/OneDrive/Desktop`
- `C:/Users/nimab/OneDrive/Documents/ChatGPT/Neuvetra`

The OneDrive project search reported access denied for root `.pytest_cache`, `apps/site-api/src/calculation/.pytest_cache`, and `.superpowers/epa-repair-23/qa-carry-1mkapy_p`; those locations were not searched successfully. Node modules, Git internals, data/pgdata directories and secret/environment filename patterns were excluded.

An additional content search restricted to HANDOFF and README filenames within `claude-dev` found no `e1377ca`, `f89cb214`, `run-r43`, `R43-README`, or `2026-10-31-scope3-completion` references (rg exit 1). Earlier Scope 3 package folders dated October 25–27 exist, including `2026-10-27-scope3-package2-r2`; none is accepted as the missing completion package.

Download archive inventory found `package.zip` dated July 23. Its 54 entry names have no Scope 3/R43/HANDOFF/changes.patch match. Only archive entry names were inspected; no archive member contents were read or extracted. Other download archives were earlier M59 or unrelated application setup archives. No completion-named archive was found in the filename search.

The root's provided commit/tree pins (`e1377ca`, `f89cb214`, `b6d5d548`) and main `143bac1838701c97f1e4ce07879b5cab2cb3575e` remain **inherited context, not independently verified Git findings of this preflight**.

## Scope, checks and next owner

[PREFLIGHT-ENGINEERING.json](PREFLIGHT-ENGINEERING.json) contains the exact inventory/search commands, outputs and per-command exit results. For scripts with multiple commands, the recorded shell exit alone is not used as evidence of each child operation; explicit child exit values, search records and captured errors govern.

No baseline tests, R43 runner, SQL, migrations, database connections, cluster initialization, installs, starts/stops, hosted checks, source edits, merge, deployment or release were performed. Secret/environment file contents and customer data were not read.

The engineering-preflight observations and artifacts are delivered for independent review; the PG16 binary prerequisite is resolved, while package execution readiness remains unresolved. The coordinator's next steps are to obtain the actual completion package and verify its provenance against the intended Git baseline. Inspect its runner and README before choosing the execution shell/context. PostgreSQL 16.15 tool availability is not a database or R43 test pass.

Requested compute: `gpt-6-astra/high`; observed compute: **unknown**. Verified CTO prompt SHA-256: `1368166de5ee8c4d399f3d3b4b26e94a92c99de2fd2ad6389fdf7b78f8a054f1`. Registry critical route was read directly. The root reports a dispatch-controller failure from inherited `HOSTED-SETUP-SOURCE-LOCK-01` artifact mismatch; this task did not rerun that controller, modify historical evidence or change role defaults. Root owns shared ledgers and the notes index. Applicable evidence lessons: L02 (provenance) and L04 (accurate unrun/partial-check labeling).
